verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows LM Studio acting as an MCP client—installing and connecting to external MCP servers to extend its local models (lm-studio-docs-3, lm-studio-docs-19)—not LM Studio exposing an official MCP server that other agents could connect to. As a local model runtime/platform, shipping an official MCP server endpoint is a plausible axis, so its absence is 'none' rather than 'na'.
